title: How I jumped from Band 6.0 to 7.5 in Reading in 3 weeks
content: My biggest bottleneck was spending 26 minutes on Passage 1 trying to understand every scientific noun. Switching to a strict 17-20-23 minute split and underlining contrast markers ('nevertheless', 'conversely') before reading options lifted my score from 25/40 to 34/40!

title: Task 2 Thesis Check: Remote Work & City Centres — too broad?
content: Does this thesis clearly satisfy Band 7 Task Response for 'Discuss both views and give your opinion'? 'While remote work invigorates small regional towns, unadapted downtown districts face fiscal decline; nevertheless, converting vacant offices into housing makes flexible work a net gain.' Feedback welcome!

title: Looking for daily 20-min Part 2 & 3 speaking drills (Target 7.5)
content: I am taking IELTS Academic on December 18 and would love to swap daily cue card timing + constructive feedback over voice calls around 7 PM EST.

title: Achieved Overall 8.0 (L:8.5 R:8.0 W:7.5 S:7.5) — Full breakdown!
content: Sharing what actually moved my Writing from 6.5 to 7.5: cutting memorised clichés and planning 2 crystal-clear topic sentences before typing. Happy to answer questions on Mock Test pacing.

title: Trick for catching plural 's' in Part 4 Lecture Completion
content: Whenever the prompt has no article ('a/an') before a blank and fits a countable noun, quickly check surrounding verbs ('require ___' vs 'a single ___') during the 30-second preview!

title: 10 high-value verbs to replace 'increase' in Task 1 graphs
content: Instead of repeating 'increased' five times, rotate: climbed steadily, surged markedly, edged upward, rebounded sharply, and plateaued after 2020.

title: Do I need a conclusion paragraph in Academic Writing Task 1?
content: No! Keep your clear Overview paragraph right after the introduction. Spending words on a separate summary conclusion often repeats data unnecessarily.

title: Cue Card Tip: Stop aiming for complex stories, aim for vivid detail
content: Examiners don't grade creativity—describing a simple walk along a local canal with crisp adjectives ('windswept', 'restorative') beats inventing an awkward fake adventure.

title: Why Matching Headings should be solved paragraph-by-paragraph
content: Read Paragraph A first, summarise its central theme in 4 words in your scratchpad, and only THEN scan the Roman numeral heading options. It prevents distractors from planting bias.

title: Completed 3 Full 2h 40m Mock Exams — Stamina truly matters!
content: Before practising full back-to-back mocks, my brain felt exhausted halfway through Writing Task 2. Building test-day stamina made the actual exam feel routine.
